## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what the problem is (e.g. "I find it hard to track bills when...").

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Why It Matters
Explain who benefits from this feature and what use case it supports.

## Alternatives
A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or reference links here.
